description: This file defines the internal class ConfirmationWorker<TState> which manages transaction confirmation and collection logic within Orleans Transactions, including participant notification, retries, and cleanup.

classes.name: ConfirmationWorker<TState>
classes.description: Manages transaction confirmation, participant notification, retries, and cleanup within Orleans Transactions.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a transaction ID to pending confirmations and initiates confirmation process.

methods.name: IsConfirmed
methods.description: Checks if a transaction ID has been confirmed.

methods.name: SendConfirmation
methods.description: Sends confirmation messages to all participants and initiates collection.

methods.name: NotifyAll
methods.description: Notifies all participants (except self) of a transaction confirmation, with retries until success.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Retries collection of a transaction from the commit log until successful.

methods.name: TryCollect
methods.description: Attempts to remove a transaction from the commit log and updates pending set.
